$comment: Documentation of the text artifacts used by the anchor-geometry skill. All coordinates are in PAGE space with origin TOP-LEFT, y growing DOWN (the pdftotext -bbox / PyMuPDF convention). All files are UTF-8. JSONL = one JSON object per line.

annotation_id.doc: unique id of the raw mark; never fabricated, carried through verbatim

file.doc: source document name; resolves to pages/<file>/page-NNN.words.tsv

page.doc: 1-based page number; TSV name is zero-padded to 3 digits

type.doc: PDF annotation type: Highlight | Underline | Squiggly | StrikeOut | FreeText | Ink | ... ; preserved verbatim, never merged into one bucket

category.doc: task-level tag (e.g. evidence, question); preserved verbatim

color_rgb.doc: mark color; preserved verbatim, never bucketed

quadpoints.type: array of number, length multiple of 8
quadpoints.doc: x1 y1 x2 y2 x3 y3 x4 y4 per quad, already converted to top-left origin; each quad is reduced to its bounding rect

contents.doc: recorded quote or note text; used by drift_correct as the re-anchor target

words_tsv.format: tab-separated, one word per line, optional #-comment header lines
words_tsv.doc: word index i (0-based, file order after skipping comments) is the stable word id referenced by word_indices

resolved_jsonl.doc: every input field is preserved verbatim; the following fields are added

added_fields.anchored_text: marked text, words joined in (column, line_y, x0) reading order; for nearest_block: the nearest line's text
added_fields.word_indices: 0-based word ids (file order) used, in join order
added_fields.bbox: union of quad rects (the mark geometry); for nearest_block: the block box
added_fields.quad_count: number of quads processed (area marks only)
added_fields.coverage: fraction of total quad area covered by matched words, 0..1 (null for nearest_block)
added_fields.column_count: columns detected on the page via x-projection gutters (>=8 units of zero coverage with words on both sides)
added_fields.column_gutters_x: x positions of detected gutters (only when column_count > 1)
added_fields.anchor_distance: euclidean distance from mark rect center to nearest block (nearest_block only)

summary.exact | normalized | drifted | failed |: counts; classes: ratio>=0.99 exact, >=0.90 normalized, >=0.60 drifted, <0.60 failed

anchors.ratio: difflib ratio of normalized recorded vs re-clipped text (null when skipped)
anchors.reclip_text: independently re-clipped text (word-center-inside rule, per-quad rects, column-aware order)

corrected_jsonl.doc: resolved.jsonl plus a 'correction' object per record; corrected records also get bbox/quadpoints/word_indices/anchored_text replaced by the winning window
